verdict: Yes. Get-A-Whey from Mumbai pitched protein-rich, healthy ice cream on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Buyers want to enjoy ice cream without the sugar, and protein and sugar-free versions have a growing market.
angle: Health-conscious buyers and diabetics look for lower-sugar desserts. Protein ice cream appeals to gym-goers. Taste must match regular ice cream for repeat purchases.
